data.name: STM_001
data.value: This heat is suffocating...[pause=15] We must be nearing a magma pocket.

data.name: STM_002
data.value: Hear that, [player]?[pause=15] Sounds like... pressurized steam.

data.name: STM_003
data.value: Steam![pause=10] It's coming from everywhere!

data.name: STM_004
data.value: A Torkoal![pause=10] It's blocking our path!

data.name: STM_005
data.value: A Magmar too![pause=10] They've surrounded us!

data.name: STM_006
data.value: The Forge-Masters of the depths...

data.name: STM_007
data.value: That voice again!

data.name: STM_008
data.value: They have guarded the furnaces for centuries.[pause=20] Their heat will consume you.

data.name: STM_009
data.value: Unless you prove your own flame...

data.name: STM_010
data.value: We didn't come all this way for nothing![pause=10] [player], let's go!

data.name: STM_011
data.value: We're back.[pause=15] This time, we're ready!

data.name: STM_012
data.value: We survived the furnace!

data.name: STM_013
data.value: That voice...[pause=15] It seems to know everything about this dungeon.

data.name: STM_014
data.value: It's like it's testing us.[pause=20] Let's continue.

data.name: STM_015
data.value: The flames consumed you...

data.name: STM_016
data.value: But fire tempers steel.[pause=30] Return, stronger.

data.name: STM_017
data.value: Je...[pause=5] je ne peux plus...[pause=15] On doit reculer !

data.name: STM_018
data.value: Torkoal souffle un panache de fumée noire.[pause=15] Magmar ricane.[pause=10] La chaleur est insoutenable.

data.name: STM_019
data.value: Les flammes ne font que commencer.[pause=20] Reviens quand tu pourras les supporter.

data.name: STM_020
data.value: Ils retournent dans la fournaise.[pause=20] Les braises crépitent dans l'obscurité.

data.name: STM_021
data.value: Magmar s'écroule, ses flammes vacillent.[pause=10] Torkoal recule,[pause=5] sa carapace fumante.

data.name: STM_022
data.value: Torkoal te fixe de ses yeux rouges.[pause=20] Un long silence.

data.name: STM_023
data.value: Ta flamme...[pause=20] est plus forte que la nôtre.[pause=25] Passe.

data.name: STM_024
data.value: Ils s'enfoncent dans le tunnel en fusion,[pause=15] leurs braises s'éteignant peu à peu.

data.name: STM_025
data.value: On a survécu à la fournaise ![pause=10] Littéralement !

data.name: STM_026
data.value: Même le feu s'incline devant ta détermination.[pause=25] Continue.
